title: Register by 9 October for 10 % off the IFRA Global Fragrance Summit 2027
summary: Registration is open for the IFRA Global Fragrance Summit 2027 , which takes place at The St. Regis Mumbai, India, on 23 – 24 June 2027 . Register by Friday, 9 October 2026 and save 10 % with the super-early-bird code GFS 27 -SUPEREARLY .
